rights.en:
📜 HUMAN RIGHTS IN ZIMBABWE

Under the Zimbabwe Constitution (Chapter 4 - Bill of Rights), every person has:

• Right to life
• Right to personal liberty
• Freedom from torture or cruel treatment
• Freedom of expression and media
• Freedom of assembly and association
• Right to education
• Right to health care
• Right to clean water
• Right to shelter
• Right to work and fair labour practices
• Right to vote
• Right to administrative justice
• Rights of arrested and detained persons
• Right to privacy

These rights apply to ALL persons in Zimbabwe, regardless of nationality, race, gender, religion, or political affiliation.

For detailed information, type 'documents' to download guides.
rights.sn:
📜 KODZERO DZAVANHU MUZIMBABWE

Pasi pemutemo weZimbabwe (Chitsauko 4 - Bill of Rights), munhu wese ane:

• Kodzero yekurarama
• Kodzero yekusununguka
• Kusununguka kubva mukutambudzwa
• Kusununguka kwekutaura nekufambisa mashoko
• Kusununguka kwekuungana nekushamwaridzana
• Kodzero yekudzidza
• Kodzero yekurapwa
• Kodzero yemvura yakachena
• Kodzero yekugara
• Kodzero yekushanda nemaitiro akanaka
• Kodzero yekuvhotera
• Kodzero yekutongwa zvakanaka
• Kodzero dzavanhu vakabatwa nekuvharirwa
• Kodzero yekuvanzika

Idzi kodzero dzinoshanda kumunhu wese ari muZimbabwe, pasina musiyano werudzi, jenderi, chitendero, kana mafambiro ezvematongerwo.

Kuti uwane ruzivo ruzere, nyora 'documents' kuti udhawunirodhe magwaro.
rights.nd:
📜 AMALUNGELO ABANTU E-ZIMBABWE

Ngaphansi komthethosisekelo we-Zimbabwe (Isahluko 4 - Bill of Rights), wonke umuntu unamalungelo:

• Ilungelo lokuphila
• Ilungelo lenkululeko
• Inkululeko yokuhlukunyezwa
• Inkululeko yokukhuluma nokwethula ulwazi
• Inkululeko yokuhlangana nokuhlanganyela
• Ilungelo lokufunda
• Ilungelo lokwelashwa
• Ilungelo lamanzi ahlanzekileyo
• Ilungelo lokuhlala
• Ilungelo lokusebenza ngendlela efanele
• Ilungelo lokuvota
• Ilungelo lokuphathwa ngokufanele
• Amalungelo abantu ababoshiweyo
• Ilungelo lokugcina ubumfihlo

Lamalungelo asebenza kubo bonke abantu e-Zimbabwe, ngaphandle kokwehlukanisa ngesizwe, ubulili, inkolo, noma ezombusazwe.

Ukuze uthole ulwazi oluningiliziwe, bhala 'documents' ukulanda amadokhumenti.

complaint.en:
📋 HOW TO FILE A COMPLAINT WITH ZHRC

If your human rights have been violated, you can file a complaint with ZHRC:

Step 1: Gather information
• What happened?
• When and where did it happen?
• Who was involved?
• Any evidence (photos, documents, witnesses)

Step 2: Contact ZHRC
• Visit any ZHRC office (type 'offices' for locations)
• Call our hotline
• Email: complaints@zhrc.org.zw
• Submit online through our website

Step 3: What to expect
• ZHRC will investigate your complaint
• You may be asked to provide more details
• ZHRC can mediate, investigate, or refer to other authorities
• Your identity can be kept confidential

Step 4: Follow up
• You will receive a reference number
• Use it to check on your complaint status

⚠️ For emergencies (immediate danger), call Police: 999 first, then contact ZHRC.
complaint.sn:
📋 MAITIRO EKUTAURA NYAYA KUZHRC

Kana kodzero dzako dzavanhu dzakaputsiwa, unogona kutaura nyaya kuZHRC:

Chikamu 1: Unganidza ruzivo
• Chii chakaitika?
• Chakaitika rini nepapi?
• Ndiani akabatanidzwa?
• Humboo (mifananidzo, magwaro, zvapupu)

Chikamu 2: Taura naZHRC
• Shanyira chero ofisi yeZHRC (nyora 'offices' kuti uwane maofisi)
• Fona hotline yedu
• Email: complaints@zhrc.org.zw
• Tumira online kuburikidza newebsite yedu

Chikamu 3: Chii chaunotarisira
• ZHRC ichanzwisisa nyaya yako
• Unogona kubvunzwa kuti upe ruzivo rwakawanda
• ZHRC inogona kuyananisa, kunzwisisa, kana kutumira kumamwe masangano
• Zita rako ringachengetwa sechakavanzika

Chikamu 4: Tevedzera
• Uchapiwa nhamba yekutaurirana
• Shandisa iyo kuti uone mamiriro enyaya yako

⚠️ Kune zvinokurumidza (ngozi inokurumidza), fona mapurisa: 999 pakutanga, ipapo taura naZHRC.
complaint.nd:
📋 INDLELA YOKUFAKA ISIKHALAZO KU-ZHRC

Uma amalungelo akho abantu ephulwe, ungafaka isikhalazo ku-ZHRC:

Isigaba 1: Qoqa ulwazi
• Kwenzekeni?
• Kwenzeka nini naphi?
• Ngubani obandakanyekile?
• Ubufakazi (izithombe, amadokhumenti, ofakazi)

Isigaba 2: Xhumana ne-ZHRC
• Vakashela noma which office ye-ZHRC (bhala 'offices' ukuthola amahhovisi)
• Shayela i-hotline yethu
• I-imeyli: complaints@zhrc.org.zw
• Thumela online nge-website yethu

Isigaba 3: Okulindelwe
• I-ZHRC izophenya isikhalazo sakho
• Ungabuzwa ukuthi unikeze ulwazi oluningi
• I-ZHRC ingaxazulula, iphenye, noma idlulisele kwezinye iziphathimandla
• Igama lakho lingagcinwa libe yimfihlo

Isigaba 4: Landela
• Uzothola inombolo yokulandela
• Isebenzise ukubheka isimo sesikhalazo sakho

⚠️ Kwezinto eziphuthumayo (ingozi ephuthumayo), shayela amaphoyisa: 999 kuqala, bese uxhumana ne-ZHRC.

services.en:
🏛️ WHAT ZHRC DOES

The Zimbabwe Human Rights Commission (ZHRC) is an independent constitutional body established to:

1. Promote human rights
   • Educate the public about human rights
   • Conduct awareness campaigns
   • Publish human rights reports

2. Protect human rights
   • Investigate complaints of violations
   • Monitor detention facilities and prisons
   • Visit places of detention

3. Advise government
   • Provide advice on human rights legislation
   • Review laws and policies for compliance
   • Engage with Parliament

4. Monitor and report
   • Monitor human rights situation in Zimbabwe
   • Produce annual reports
   • Engage with international bodies

5. Research
   • Conduct human rights research
   • Publish findings

For more information, type 'offices' to find your nearest ZHRC office.
services.sn:
🏛️ ZVINONZI ZHRC

Zimbabwe Human Rights Commission (ZHRC) isangano rakazvimirira rakagadzwa nemutemo kuti:

1. Kukurudzira kodzero dzavanhu
   • Kudzidzisa vanhu nezve kodzero dzavanhu
   • Kuita mitsara yekuzivisa
   • Kuparura magwaro nezve kodzero dzavanhu

2. Kudzivirira kodzero dzavanhu
   • Kunzwisisa nyaya dzekuputsiwa kwekodzero
   • Kuongorora nzvimbo dzekuvharirwa nezvekudzivirira
   • Kushanyira nzvimbo dzekuvharirwa

3. Kupa mazano kuhurumende
   • Kupa mazano pamitemo yekodzero dzavanhu
   • Kuongorora mitemo nemitemo yekutevedzera
   • Kushamwaridzana neParamende

4. Kuongorora nekuparura
   • Kuongorora mamiriro ekodzero dzavanhu muZimbabwe
   • Kuparura magwaro egore negore
   • Kushamwaridzana nemasangano epasi rose

5. Kutsvagisa
   • Kuita tsvagiso yekodzero dzavanhu
   • Kuparura zvakawanikwa

Kuti uwane ruzivo rwakawanda, nyora 'offices' kuti uwane ofisi yeZHRC iri pedyo newe.
services.nd:
🏛️ OKWENZIWA YI-ZHRC

I-Zimbabwe Human Rights Commission (ZHRC) yisikhungo esizimele esasungwa ngomthethosisekelo ukuthi:

1. Kukhuthaza amalungelo abantu
   • Ukufundisa umphakathi ngamalungelo abantu
   • Ukuqhuba imikhankaso yokwazisa
   • Ukushicilela imibiko yamalungelo abantu

2. Ukuvikela amalungelo abantu
   • Uku phenya izikhalazo zokuphulwa kwamalungelo
   • Ukuqapha izindawo zokuboshwa
   • Ukuhlola izindawo zokuboshwa

3. Ukunikeza iseluleko kuhulumeni
   • Ukunikeza iseluleko ngomthetho wamalungelo abantu
   • Ukuhlola imithetho neziphakamiso
   • Ukusebenzisana nePhalamende

4. Ukuqapha nokubika
   • Ukuqapha isimo samalungelo abantu e-Zimbabwe
   • Ukushicilela imibiko yonyaka
   • Ukusebenzisana nezinhlangano zomhlaba

5. Ucwaningo
   • Ukuqhuba ucwaningo lwamalungelo abantu
   • Ukushicilela okutholakele

Ukuze uthole ulwazi oluningi, bhala 'offices' ukuthola ihhovisi ye-ZHRC eliseduze nawe.

faq.en:
❓ FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Q: What is ZHRC?
A: The Zimbabwe Human Rights Commission is an independent constitutional body that promotes and protects human rights in Zimbabwe.

Q: Who can file a complaint?
A: Anyone! Zimbabwean citizens, residents, refugees, or any person in Zimbabwe whose rights have been violated.

Q: Is it free to file a complaint?
A: Yes, completely free. ZHRC does not charge for its services.

Q: Can I remain anonymous?
A: Yes, you can file a complaint anonymously or request confidentiality.

Q: What happens after I file a complaint?
A: ZHRC will investigate, may mediate, and can refer to other authorities if needed. You'll receive a reference number to track progress.

Q: How long does it take?
A: It varies depending on complexity. Simple cases may take weeks, complex ones may take months.

Q: Can ZHRC help with labour disputes?
A: ZHRC can investigate human rights aspects of labour issues. For pure labour disputes, contact the Labour Court.

Q: What if my rights are violated by a private company?
A: ZHRC can investigate violations by both state and non-state actors, including private companies.
faq.sn:
❓ MIBVUNZO INOBVUNZWA KAZHINJI

M: ZHRC chii?
P: Zimbabwe Human Rights Commission isangano rakazvimirira rakagadzwa nemutemo rinosimudzira nekudzivirira kodzero dzavanhu muZimbabwe.

M: Ndiani anogona kutaura nyaya?
P: Ani zvake! Vagari veZimbabwe, vanogara muZimbabwe, vapoteri, kana munhu wese ari muZimbabwe akaputsiwa kodzero dzake.

M: Kuti taura nyaya kune mari?
P: Aihwa, mahara zvizere. ZHRC haina mari yekutaura nyaya.

M: Ndingaramba ndisina kuzivikanwa?
P: Hongu, unogona kutaura nyaya usina kuzivikanwa kana kukumbira kuti ruzivo rwako rwuve chakavanzika.

M: Chii chinoitika shure kwekutaura nyaya?
P: ZHRC ichanzwisisa, inogona kuyananisa, uye inogona kutumira kumamwe masangano kana zvichidikanwa. Uchapiwa nhamba yekutevedzera.

M: Inotora nguva yakadii?
P: Zvinosiyana zvichienderana nekuoma kwenyaya. Nyaya dzakareruka dzinogona kutora masvondo, dzinonetsa dzinogona kutora mwedzi.

M: ZHRC inogona kubatsira nezvekupesana kwemabasa?
P: ZHRC inogona kunzwisisa zvikamu zvekodzero dzavanhu zvemabasa. Kune kupesana kwemabasa kwakachena, taura neLabour Court.

M: Kana kodzero dzangu dzakaputsiwa nekambani yega?
P: ZHRC inogona kunzwisisa kuputsiwa kwekodzero nevanhu vese, vachiramba nekambani dzevega.
faq.nd:
❓ IMIBUZO EVAMILE

M: I-ZHRC yini?
P: I-Zimbabwe Human Rights Commission yisikhungo esizimele esasungwa ngomthethosisekelo esikhuthaza futhi esivikela amalungelo abantu e-Zimbabwe.

M: Ngubani ongafaka isikhalazo?
P: Wonke umuntu! Izakhamuzi ze-Zimbabwe, abahlali, abaphembele, noma noma ngubani e-Zimbabwe onamalungelo akhe aphulwe.

M: Kuyadula ukufaka isikhalazo?
P: Cha, mahhala ngokuphelele. I-ZHRC ayikhokhisi ngamasevisi ayo.

M: Ngingahlala ngingaziwa?
P: Yebo, ungafaka isikhalazo ungaziwa noma ucele ukuthi ulwazi lwakho lugcinwe libe yimfihlo.

M: Kwenzekani ngemva kokufaka isikhalazo?
P: I-ZHRC izophenya, ingaxazulula, futhi ingadlulisele kwezinye iziphathimandla uma kudingeka. Uzothola inombolo yokulandela.

M: Kuthatha isikhathi esingakanani?
P: Kuyahluka kuye ngobunzima besikhalazo. Izikhalazo ezilula zingathatha amasonto, ezinzima zingathatha izinyanga.

M: I-ZHRC ingasiza ngodaba lwezabasebenzi?
P: I-ZHRC ingaphenya izingxenye zamalungelo abantu ezindabeni zabasebenzi. Kwezindaba ezicacile zezabasebenzi, xhumana ne-Labour Court.

M: Uma amalungelo ami ephulwe inkampani yangasese?
P: I-ZHRC ingaphenya ukuphulwa kwamalungelo ngabantu bonke, kubandakanya nezinkampani zangasese.
